notes: No horizontal scroll or clipped content at any width (checked 375px hardest per the checklist); single quiet column, generous spacing, calm agenda at all three widths.

Match names read in full, not truncated in a way that hides key info; Apollon Limassol – Brann row reads 'VG+ Sport' in full at both 375 and 393 (double-checked at higher resolution after an initial low-res read looked ambiguous).

Every event shows a where-to-watch line and all channels are Norwegian (NRK, TV 2 Play, VG+ Sport, Viaplay, Direktesport/Avisa Nordland, EuroVolley.tv, HBO Max (Sport)) — no FOX/ESPN/Sky seen. The National Bank Open row correctly shows an honest faint '–' for an unknown channel instead of guessing.
Times present and sensibly formatted; competition/round context shown under each fixture (e.g. 'UEFA Champions League 2026/27 (kvalifisering)').
National flags and club crests render as icons, not broken-image placeholders (Norwegian flag, Bodø/Glimt, Brann, PSG, KFUM Oslo, La Liga crests all checked).
Must-see accent dots used sparingly (EM friidrett, Sandvolleyball-EM, Rosenborg-Viking, etc.), not on every row.
Header, day headings, footer, and 'Dette dekker vi' / 'Merker og kilder' disclosures all intact and aligned at every width.

The floating Assistent button rests over a mid-agenda row at all three widths (e.g. 'Sandvolleyball-EM' row at 900px, 'Bodø/Glimt – Union Saint-Gilloise' row at 375px) — DESIGN.md-sanctioned (WP-146 variant D), not flagged. Did not observe it covering the last agenda/news row or the footer. At 900px the column is centered with symmetric margins and the button sits mostly in the right margin beside it, per design.
Could not assess: real browser tap-target/interaction behavior (only static screenshots reviewed).
